info.name: Crumb & Co. — Backend API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Crumb & Co. e-commerce backend (Express v5 + Prisma).

## Setup
1. Start the server: `npm run dev` (defaults to http://localhost:4000).
2. Seed the database: `npm run db:seed` (creates the admin `admin@crumbco.dev` / `Admin123!`, products).
3. Import the environment `crumb-and-co.environment.json` and select it.

## How to run
- Run the whole collection in order (Auth → Me → Users → Categories → Products → Cart → Orders → Cleanup).
- Tokens are captured automatically: Login requests store the JWT in the environment variable `accessToken` / `adminAccessToken`, which every protected request reads.
- Refresh tokens are httpOnly cookies. Each login stores its refresh token in a per-account env var (`customerRefreshToken` / `adminRefreshToken` / `managedRefreshToken`). All accounts are logged out in the Cleanup folder, which also resets the token/user-id env vars.
- Re-running: Register requests require a fresh email (a 409 duplicate will fail the test) — clear the email variables in the environment or use new ones to re-run. Product creation tolerates 409 and reuses the seeded product captured from the list endpoints.

## Auth model
- Register/login → access JWT (Bearer). Refresh token delivered via httpOnly cookie on `/api/v1/auth`.
- Admin endpoints require an ADMIN account. New admins are created by an existing admin via POST /admins (there is no role-changing endpoint).
- Customers can delete their own account via DELETE /me (hard delete; order history is detached and kept). Admin accounts cannot delete themselves.
- Mock payment provider auto-marks orders PAID.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Register, login, refresh, logout. Tokens are saved to environment variables for downstream requests.

item.name: Register Managed User
item.description: Second account used by the admin-management tests in the Users folder. On re-runs this 409s (already registered) — the id is captured reliably by the following Login Managed User request.

item.name: Login Managed User
item.description: Always returns the managed user's id (even on re-runs when registration 409s), so `managedUserId` is reliably set for the Users folder.

item.name: Login Admin
item.description: Uses the seeded admin (see `npm run db:seed`).

item.name: Refresh
item.description: Reads the httpOnly `refreshToken` cookie automatically. Rotates the session and returns a fresh access token.

item.name: Register — invalid payload (400)
item.description: Shows the real validation error shape: `details` is an array of {field, message}.

exec: pm.test('details is an array of {field, message}', () => {

item.name: Refresh — without cookie (401)
item.description: Sends NO cookies for this request via protocolProfileBehavior.disableCookies, so the httpOnly refreshToken cookie is never attached → 'Missing refresh token'. (pm.cookies.jar() cannot remove httpOnly cookies, so per-request cookie disabling is the reliable fix.)

item.name: Login — rate limited (429)
item.description: Fires 6 rapid login attempts in the pre-request script to exhaust the auth limiter (5/min), then this login should be blocked. Note: this test locks out /auth/login and /auth/refresh for about a minute, so it runs last.

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: pm.environment.get('customerEmail'), password: 'wrong' }) }

item.name: Me
item.description: Current authenticated user (customer token).

item.name: Get Me
item.description: Requires a valid access token. Run 'Auth > Login Customer' first — it stores the JWT in the environment variable `accessToken`, which this request sends as `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

exec: throw new Error('accessToken is empty — run "Auth > Login Customer" first (and make sure the "Crumb & Co. — Local" environment is selected).');

item.name: Update Me — email already in use (409)
item.description: Tries to change the customer's email to another existing user's email (the managed user).

item.name: Users (Admin)
item.description: Admin-only user management.

item.name: Register Admin
item.description: Admin creates another admin account (there is no role-changing endpoint — new admins must be registered). Stores the new admin credentials in `newAdminEmail` / `newAdminPassword`.

item.name: Toggle User Active
item.description: Activates or deactivates the managed user. Role is never changed here — admins can only toggle isActive, and new admins come from POST /admins.

exec: if (!managedId) throw new Error('managedUserId is empty — run "Auth > Login Managed User" first (the Cleanup folder clears it).');
if (!adminToken) throw new Error('adminAccessToken is empty — run "Auth > Login Admin" first.');

item.name: Change Role — rejected (400)
item.description: Role changes are no longer supported. Sending `role` fails validation, so no customer can be promoted to admin.

exec: if (!managedId) throw new Error('managedUserId is empty — run "Auth > Login Managed User" first (the Cleanup folder clears it).');
if (!adminToken) throw new Error('adminAccessToken is empty — run "Auth > Login Admin" first.');

item.name: List Users — customer token (403)
item.description: Customer token hitting an admin-only route.

item.name: List Users — invalid limit (400)
item.description: limit must be between 1 and 100.

item.name: Products
item.description: Products are public to read; writes are admin-only.

item.name: Get Product by Slug
item.description: Uses a seeded product and captures its id for the cart/checkout flow.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Chai Spice Cookie",
  "slug": "chai-spice-cookie",
  "description": "Warm chai spices in a chewy butter cookie.",
  "price": 4.25,
  "stock": 50,
  "rating": 4.8,
  "tag": "New",
  "imageUrl": "https://example.com/chai.jpg"
}

exec: pm.test('201 on first run (409 if slug exists)', () => pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: Update Product
item.description: Updates the product created above (requires `createdProductId`).

exec: pm.test('details point to the name field', () => {

item.name: Cart
item.description: Customer-only cart. Admin tokens get 403 on every cart endpoint. The last request re-adds an item so the cart-based checkout in the Orders folder has stock to buy.

item.name: Add Cart Item — invalid product id (400)
Add Cart Item — product not found (404)
item.description: Valid UUID but the product does not exist.

item.name: Update Cart Item — not in cart (404)
item.description: The product is not in the customer's cart.

item.name: Remove Cart Item — not in cart (404)

item.description: Cart routes are customer-only. An admin token must get 403 on all cart endpoints.
item.name: Add Cart Item - admin forbidden (403)
Orders
item.description: Checkout from the logged-in customer's cart, listing, single order, admin status updates. Mock payment auto-pays, so orders are created as PAID. Guest checkout is not supported.

item.name: Checkout — unauthenticated (401)
item.description: Guest checkout is not supported. Posting to /orders without a token is rejected with 401, even when `items` are provided.

item.name: Checkout (cart)
item.description: Authenticated checkout from the user's cart (clears it after). Guest checkout is not supported — a token is required.

item.name: Update Order Status
item.description: Admin moves the paid order from PAID → PROCESSING.

item.name: Checkout — items rejected (400)
item.description: The checkout schema no longer accepts `items` (guest checkout removed). An authenticated request sending `items` fails validation.

item.name: Update Order Status — invalid transition (409)
item.description: Tries to move the paid order back to PENDING, which is not a valid transition from PAID or PROCESSING.

item.name: Update Order Status as Customer (403)
item.description: A customer trying to update an order status (admin-only action).

item.name: Get Order — not found (404)
item.description: A valid UUID that does not exist.

item.name: Checkout — empty cart (409)
item.description: Authenticated checkout while the cart is empty → conflict. (Cart was cleared by the happy-path checkout.)

item.name: Cleanup
item.description: Deletes the product created during this run (soft delete), logs out all accounts and clears the token/user env vars.

item.name: Logout Customer
item.description: Replays the customer's captured refresh token as the `refreshToken` cookie so the server revokes that account's session.

item.name: Logout Admin
item.description: Replays the admin's captured refresh token as the `refreshToken` cookie so the server revokes that account's session.

item.name: Logout Managed User
item.description: Replays the managed user's captured refresh token as the `refreshToken` cookie so the server revokes that account's session.

item.name: Delete Product
item.description: Soft deletes `createdProductId` (sets isActive=false). Kept last so the cart/order flows still have stock.

item.name: Clear Environment Variables
item.description: Resets every token/user-id env var captured during the run so a fresh run starts clean.
